import numpy as np

def score_merge_static(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, i_idx, j_idx):
    d0i = distance_matrix[0, i_idx]
    d0j = distance_matrix[0, j_idx]
    dij = distance_matrix[i_idx, j_idx]

    savings = d0i + d0j - dij
    scale = np.where((d0i + d0j) > 1e-12, d0i + d0j, 1e-12)
    norm_savings = savings / scale

    di = demands[i_idx]
    dj = demands[j_idx]
    combined = di + dj
    feasible = combined <= capacity
    fill = np.where(capacity > 1e-12, combined / capacity, 0.0)
    fill = np.clip(fill, 0.0, 1.0)
    util = fill * fill
    max_d = np.maximum(di, dj) / np.where(capacity > 1e-12, capacity, 1.0)

    dep = (d0i + d0j) / scale

    score = (
        0.40 * norm_savings
        + 0.30 * util
        + 0.15 * savings / (1.0 + scale)
        + 0.10 * dep
        + 0.05 * max_d
    )

    # Deterministic lexicographic tie-break, folded into a tiny monotone term.
    n = distance_matrix.shape[0]
    tie = -(i_idx.astype(np.float64) * float(n) + j_idx.astype(np.float64))
    score = score + 1e-9 * tie

    score = np.where(feasible, score, -1.0 - np.abs(score))
    score = np.where(np.isfinite(score), score, -1e9)
    return score.astype(np.float64)
